capabilities: Rewrite pasted image wiki-links to standard Markdown image syntax
Convert bare links [](...) and non-image-prefixed wiki links of images to ![](...)
Leave already-correct Markdown image links and non-image wiki links untouched
Resolve image paths at any attachment folder depth
extras: README warns that if the plugin is not working after install you must disable and re-enable it; bilingual English/Chinese documentation.
intentEvidence: This plugin intercepts that and rewrites the link to ![](filename.png)
problem: Obsidian inserts pasted images as wiki-links or bare links, which render outside Obsidian in any other Markdown renderer.
summary: Paste interceptor that rewrites Obsidian's auto-generated wiki-image links into standard Markdown image syntax ![](path).
